dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: #Right on cue, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I was just wondering whether you might appear.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Even if it were to exist solely upon the page, this teapot realm would not fail to inspire.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: And yet here I am, perceiving it with my own senses.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Naturally... I couldn't be happier.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Not to mention...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes...?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Well... I can read at my leisure here, for hours on end, without any fear of interruption. Ahh... the perfect getaway...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Shh! Not so loud...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: I wouldn't dream of neglecting any of that!

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: But please... Don't let anyone else hear you talking about it...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: My father and brother are always ready to give me another earful...

choices.text: Don't you need to keep up your martial arts practice?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: But of course! It's always a pleasure to talk with you.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Tell me, what have you been doing recently?

choices.text: Oh, y'know... escorting cargo, punishing disciples of evil...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Magnificent! Acts of pure chivalry by the sound of it.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: *sigh* Oh, how I would love to take up the sword with you... pursuing justice throughout the land!

choices.text: But your hands are tied, right?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Never mind, haha. I just had the best idea...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Why don't we have ourselves a little contest? First to a hundred chivalrous acts wins!

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: There are no restrictions on the nature of the act or the beneficiary. But you need to keep a tally. Once the act is completed, it should be verified by the other party.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm feeling pretty confident.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Hehehe...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Oh, hehe — uh... don't mind me.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Just... Don't expect to win too easily.

choices.text: I would be only too honored to have you join me.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Hehe... A pity that it will have to wait until some point in the future. But if we're talking about the here and now... Ooh! I got it...

choices.text: Driving monsters away, rescuing people from certain death... the usual.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Oh! Well, if you have the time, I'd like to get your critique on... on this short story I wrote.

choices.text: Is it the one about us?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Wow, your wits are a lot sharper these days. I must be rubbing off on you...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Y—You... Ahem... I assume you're familiar with the proverb: Be it but three moons from the start, he who returns is not he that departs.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: So... A—Anyway, I won't bore you. Feel free to peruse it at your own pace.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I can tell you really put your heart into this.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I shall keep this with me always.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Okay okay, geez... We know each other pretty well by now, no need to get all sappy.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: So remember, I want your honest opinion. That way, the sequel will be even better...

choices.text: ...I thought you were trying to keep that a secret from me?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: That was then... and this is now...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: In any case, you are a part of this story.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, for starters, your handwriting's improved a lot...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Xingqiu!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Oh...! Don't forget our arrangement. If you witness an injustice on the road, please fetch me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Xingqiu.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Good night, rest well.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I'll make sure to highlight any particularly enthralling passages I encounter and share them with you later.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Your study... is indeed unique.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: All of these rare books... many of them can hardly be found at Wanwen Bookhouse, or even in all of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Ahem... If I may so ask, where do you usually collect your literature? Perhaps you could share a tip or two with a friend, my liege...?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: This place captures the atmosphere, yet avoids such disturbances and clamor as are common to the city.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Your design for this street is most exquisite.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: A stroll here will certainly serve as inspiration for my writing!
